shadow.name: --shadow-card-value
shadow.raw:
0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 6%, transparent),
    0 14px 34px -16px color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 22%, transparent)

shadow.name: --shadow-lift-value
shadow.raw:
0 2px 4px color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 6%, transparent),
    0 28px 50px -22px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 40%, transparent)

other.name: --gradient-hero
other.raw:
radial-gradient(60% 70% at 85% 10%, var(--accent-soft) 0%, transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(50% 60% at 0% 100%, var(--secondary) 0%, transparent 70%)
